news.title: As AI advances, skills that make us human become more valuable, Mizzou expert says
news.summary_en: Anuj Kapoor answers questions about how students should approach generative artificial intelligence.

news.title: When the game changed, so did he
news.summary_en: Tyson Ellison arrived at Mizzou expecting to continue his family's football legacy. An unexpected change in direction helped him discover a new calling and a way to stay in the game.

news.title: Anatomy of Mizzou Homecoming
news.summary_en: What started as an invitation home has become one of the largest collegiate celebrations in the country.

news.title: New sit-down beehives at Mizzou’s Jefferson Farm benefit veterans, others
news.summary_en: The beehives are housed in cabinets, making beekeeping more assessable for individuals who use wheelchairs.

news.title: Mizzou researchers discover bullfrog brains can make their own backup fuel
news.summary_en: The findings could shed light on what happens when human brains don’t get enough energy.

news.title: MURR and Curium extend partnership to strengthen supply of critical cancer-fighting radioisotope
news.summary_en: Lutetium-177 — a radioisotope produced at the University of Missouri — is used in precision therapies that target and destroy cancer cells.

news.title: Mizzou researchers develop AI tool that reveals hidden clues in the gut microbiome
news.summary_en: By finding biological signals that other methods miss, the new software could help scientists flag early warning signs of disease.

news.title: Lessons in leadership: Mizzou employees expand their perspectives
news.summary_en: Through leadership development programs, faculty and staff are gaining new skills, building connections and bringing fresh ideas back to work.

news.title: Mizzou researchers help Smithsonian capture a modern picture of America’s wildlife
news.summary_en: From a living laboratory in mid-Missouri, students and faculty are contributing thousands of wildlife observations to a landmark national study.

news.title: Mizzou continues to rise in the U.S. News Best Colleges rankings
news.summary_en: Record student success and tremendous growth in breakthrough research fuel the university’s climb to a Top 100 national university.
